messages:
jamie: Quick heads-up — planned schema migration for shard-routing will start TONIGHT at 22:00 UTC. This is part of the release train window. Expect a soft freeze from 21:30 UTC.
selena: Thanks — is this the change that moves routing keys to routing_v2? Any impact on dedicated clusters?
jamie: Yes, routing_v2. Dedicated clusters are included only if the customer has opted into 'auto-route' (we checked the opt-ins list). No changes for pinned deployments.
dmitri: Rolling canaries will be 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 30-min intervals. If latency spikes at any stage we abort and rollback.
noah: Link to runbook?
jamie: Runbook here: https://confluence.redwood/ops/shard-routing-migration (internal). Key rollback command: ```kubectl -n inference set env deployment/route-proxy ROUTE_SCHEMA=default && ./scripts/force-canary-abort.sh```
sre-oncall: I'll be watching metrics on the SRE dashboard. I'll attach a quick alert: latency.p99 > 350ms for 3m triggers abort.
release-ops-bot: Deploy window scheduled: start=2025-06-12T22:00:00Z, canary_windows=[5m,25m,30m], contact=#eng-oncall.
selena: One question — will this require an image bump?
jamie: Minimal image bump: route-proxy:v4.1.2 -> v4.2.0 (includes V2 schema support). It should be backward compatible.
dmitri: Preflight checklist done: migration flags toggled in staging, integration tests passed, perf tests show +2-4% CPU on proxies.
noah: Noted. Any customer-facing maintenance notice?
jamie: We will post a short note to customers in the status page: "no expected downtime; transient latency possible during canary". No maintenance page for paid dedicated customers unless we abort.
sre-oncall: I'm creating an incident if we abort. Quick tag: #release-migration-1755012345.
dmitri: If abort needed, we'll revert routing state and scale proxies back: ```/ops/revert-routing --target=previous && kubectl rollout restart deploy/route-proxy -n inference```
selena: Will feature flags be toggled via the feature service or env var?
jamie: Feature service toggle for canary gating. Env var fallback only for emergency rollback.
noah: Are there any schema migrations that change protobuf contracts? I want to confirm clients are unaffected.
jamie: No protobuf changes. It's purely routing key renames and lookup fallback order. Clients should be unaffected.
dmitri: Canary initial phase scheduled to land in us-west-2 first. Then eu-west-1, then ap-southeast.
sre-oncall: I'll run a smoke validation script after each stage: ```./tools/smoke-check --route test-matrix --p99-threshold 250```
release-ops-bot: Canary stage updates will be posted here every 10m. Use :eyes: to subscribe.
selena: Small ask — add an explanation in the changelog entry about the new fallback behavior so infra teams don't get pinged unnecessarily.
jamie: Will do. Changelog entry draft: "Shard-routing: introduce routing_v2 with fallback to routing_v1; opt-in for auto-route customers; no client surface changes."
noah: Who's on rollback lead if we hit the abort?
dmitri: I'll lead rollback, jamie will coordinate customer comms, SRE handles paging and incident creation.
sre-oncall: Paging policy: pager hits for p99>350ms or error rate >1% for 5m. I'll escalate to oncall-2 if we don't stabilize in 10m.
dmitri: Quick note on metrics: watch route-lookup-hitratio and kv-cache-miss in addition to latency. Those will signal regressions early.
jamie: Final reminder — soft freeze at 21:30 UTC. Pushes that touch route-proxy or routing tables after that must be approved by release leads.
selena: Ack. I'll hold non-essential PRs.
noah: I'll be offline during the 22:00-23:30 window but reachable by DM for emergencies.
release-ops-bot: Deploy started: canary_1 (5%) at 2025-06-12T22:00:00Z.
jamie: Canary1 observed: p99 +10ms, error rate stable. Proceeding to 25% in 20m.
dmitri: Canary2 (25%) in progress. Slight increase in CPU, no errors.
sre-oncall: Smoke checks passing for us-west-2. eu-west-1 pulse scheduled in 18m.
noah: (DM) If we need to abort, will the rollback be automatic on alert or manual?
dmitri: Manual abort for now — ops lead approves. Automated abort is on the table for next cycle.
jamie: Update: canary reached 100% at 2025-06-12T22:55:00Z. No abort needed. Changelog and deployment note will be posted shortly. :tada:
selena: Huge thanks to the squad. I'll push the changelog and add the fallback explanation.
sre-oncall: Closing alert channel, will keep monitoring for 1h.
release-ops-bot: Deployment complete: route-proxy:v4.2.0 -> rollout succeeded. End_time=2025-06-12T23:10:00Z.
jamie: Marking release train task DONE. If you have any post-deploy regressions, ping #eng-sre and tag the thread id 1755012345.
noah: Nice work everyone.
selena: :shipit:
